description: This file defines a PHP class `Image_Graph_DataSelector_EveryNthPoint` that extends another class for selecting every Nth data point for chart rendering. It is part of the Image_Graph package under the DataSelector subpackage, used for filtering data points in graph generation.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_EveryNthPoint
classes.description: A data selector that filters and returns every Nth point from a dataset for graphing purposes.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_EveryNthpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the interval defining how often to select points.

methods.name: _select
methods.description: Determines whether a given data point should be shown based on its position in the sequence.
